segments.text: ACCEPT a few loving parting lines. Next Sunday, GOD willing, we sail in the Earl of Halifax packet. No ship offered at Philadelphia. I am almost too weary to write. JESUS made the wilderness to smile! Grace! grace! I have received letters from England, dated April 13, in answer to those sent from Georgia. All say, you must come, or Bethesda affairs cannot be finished. Expect the first intelligence after my arrival. In the mean while, cease not to remember us at the throne of that JESUS; in whose great name, I desire to subscribe myself, very dear dear friends,
